$description: Lumen v0.13 — Phase 0 semantic surface namespace. The master doc names 8 surface roles (canvas, raised, sunken, popover, glass, tint-accent, tint-strong, inverse) plus `glass-strong` for modal/sheet. This file aliases the existing v0.12.6 `color.surface.*` semantic tokens (in color.dark.tokens.json / color.light.tokens.json) under a flatter `surface.*` namespace that Phase 0+ code can consume directly. The existing `color.surface.*` paths are PRESERVED — this is additive, not destructive. Restrained mode is default (no overrides); expressive mode rebinds `surface.canvas-ambient` and `surface.hero` via modes/expressive.tokens.json.

canvas.$description: Page background. Light: paper #FAFAFA. Dark: obsidian #0D0D0D. Aliases color.surface.page.

raised.$description: Cards, panels — sits subtly above canvas via lightness alone (no chromatic tilt). Aliases color.surface.raised.

sunken.$description: Inputs at rest, table-row hover, sidebar. Aliases color.surface.sunken.

popover.$description: Floating popover surface (dropdown, menu, tooltip). Aliases color.surface.popover.

glass.$description: Floating glass shell — paired with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%). ONLY on floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, hero device frame, nav). NEVER on canvas, table, row, cell. Aliases color.surface.glass.

glass-strong.$description: v0.13 NEW — modal-tier glass with stronger blur. Paired with backdrop-filter blur(28px) saturate(160%). Used by modal scrims, sheet headers, hero device frames on expressive surfaces.

tint-accent.$description: Spring-green tinted surface — hover and selection backgrounds. Aliases color.surface.tint-accent.

tint-strong.$description: v0.13 NEW — stronger accent tint for active-state surfaces (selected nav item, active filter chip).

inverse.$description: Inverse surface — dark on light theme, light on dark theme. Used for CTA bands, footers, contrast moments. Aliases color.surface.inverse.

overlay.$description: Translucent backdrop for sticky chrome. Aliases color.surface.overlay.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim — heavy ink overlay behind dialogs. Aliases color.surface.scrim.
